request.query: string — user's question text or transcribed audio

response.answer: string — text answer in requested language
response.audio_url: string | null — URL to pre-recorded audio if verbatim path
response.escalated: boolean — true if danger-sign gate triggered
response.disclaimer: boolean — true if Tier B disclosure required
response.retrieved_ids: array[int] — KB row IDs used in answer
response.latency_ms: float | null — request latency in milliseconds

notes: If escalated=true, answer contains the fixed escalation script only
If path=verbatim, audio_url will be populated
If disclaimer=true, UI must show the Tier B disclosure banner
Do not cache on the UI side — caching is handled by the backend
